errorMissingPlatform: Missing required argument "platform". Expected one of: {{platforms}}
helpPlatformDescription: Platform to scaffold ({{platforms}}; "html" is an alias for "components", "theme-editor" is an alias for "canvas-theme-editor")
helpDirDescription: Target directory (prompts interactively on a TTY if omitted)
helpYesDescription: Never prompt; error rather than prompt for a missing platform/directory
scaffold.canvas-theme-editor.notes: Upload theme.css and theme.js to Canvas's Theme Editor (Advanced → CSS / JavaScript) so pantoken's classes are available on every page.
scaffold.canvas-theme-editor.caveats: Canvas sanitises pasted HTML server-side — always verify content pasted from the RCE preview in Canvas.
scaffold.canvas-theme-editor.i18n.pageDe: Author Canvas RCE page templates styled with pantoken, with a live preview.
scaffold.canvas-theme-editor.i18n.helpMo: Pick a starter template, edit it like you would in the Canvas Rich Content Editor, then click Copy HTML and paste the result into a Canvas page (switch to the HTML editor view first). Canvas sanitises pasted HTML server-side — this preview doesn't attempt to replicate that, so always verify the pasted result in Canvas.
Use Edit theme to change the CDN provider, theme, or mode, and to hand-edit the generated theme.css/theme.js before downloading them.
